reason: No CIF was submitted, so there is no explicit ordered realization that can be parsed, symmetry-expanded, composition-checked, chemically validated, or compared to the observed intensities. The trace does provide strong indexing support for the lattice (all 20 selected lines indexed, reported M(20) about 146), but it does not establish atomic coordinates: high-symmetry trigonal/hexagonal models had material intensity mismatches, intensity-favored models developed severe overlaps or implausible P/Mn coordination, and the final primitive P1 model was explicitly rejected after periodic-neighbor inspection found extra approximately 1.5 A P-O contacts and over-coordinated phosphate. The trace ends while proposing a return to a Z=2 hexagonal, inversion-related P2O7 search, before that model was instantiated or tested. There is also no captured final response or comparable whole-pattern score. Another attempt is therefore likely to add the materially missing valid coordinate model.
